name: flight_status
description: Get information about a specific Emirates flight when the caller names a flight number. Three tiers, clearly labelled: (1) three demo disruption records (EK17, EK001, EK957) carry full schedule detail with schedule_source 'mock'; (2) ~330 real Emirates flight numbers resolve via a route map to their city pair and typical aircraft with schedule_source 'route_map' — for these you know the ROUTE and FLEET but NOT today's times, gates or delays, so never invent them; (3) live_position is a live ADS-B transponder fix labelled by position_source. airborne false means not tracked in the air — not departed or out of coverage — and NEVER means cancelled. When schedule_source is 'route_map', speak the summary field: it is already phrased honestly.
